description: Land-use categories of the PDM (municipal master plan) of a Portuguese municipality, with buildable, floor-area index, maximum floors and regulation articles, the plan in force, and links to the municipality page and the map on pdm.xyzbim.eu. Accepts the municipality name (e.g. "Figueira da Foz", accents optional) or its 4-digit DICO code. Field values are in Portuguese. (PT: o PDM de um concelho.)
name: pdm_concelho
title: PDM of a municipality
